headline: Synopsys simulation product-engineering role includes customer AMS flows and accuracy/performance trade-offs
fact: Synopsys posted a Bengaluru product-engineering role for customer simulation and verification engagements. The position covers regression throughput, compilation and elaboration bottlenecks, debug, assertions, coverage and reference flows for block through full-chip verification. When needed, its AMS responsibilities include analog/digital co-simulation, behavioral models, Verilog-AMS integration and convergence trade-offs. AMS experience, including balancing accuracy and performance, is a preferred qualification. This is a customer-support mandate rather than evidence of a particular customer deployment.

sources.title: Synopsys: Simulation and mixed-signal verification product engineer (18747)
sources.summary: Official posting dated September 13, 2026. It assigns AMS support where needed within broader customer simulation work and describes co-simulation, behavioral modeling, Verilog-AMS and reference-flow development.
